page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is a bare-metal instance type built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 128 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, providing predictable compute performance without hyperthreading overhead. The system is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 6.0 GB per core.

This instance integrates four NVIDIA A10 GPUs, delivering a combined 96 GB of VRAM to support parallel processing workloads. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps. However, the instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage.

Given the lack of local storage, the ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is designed for workloads that rely on network-attached storage or external databases. The combination of 128 dedicated cores and quad NVIDIA A10 GPUs makes this instance suitable for deep learning inference, high-performance computing, 3D rendering, and parallelized simulation tasks. The dedicated CPU allocation and high-density GPU configuration offer high resource density, though users must factor in the latency and cost of external storage solutions.
